## Lava Weird (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
 CE Large outsider (earth, elemental, extraplanar, fire)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +7 natural, -1 size)  
 **hp** 140 (10d10+40)  
 **Fort** +10, **Ref** +6, **Will** +8  
 **DR** 10/bludgeoning; **Immune** elemental traits  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +15 (1d8+7 plus grab)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** control elemental, drown, fire, lava pool  

**Tactics**

 A lava weird prefers to hide in its lava pool until victims come within range. Once a target is close to its lava pool, the weird quickly lashes out and snatches the victim, biting it and coiling around it. It then attempts to pull the victim into its lava pool. Lava weirds are highly aggressive and prone to attack just about any creature that wanders too close to their pool.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 21, **Dex** 17, **Con** 16, **Int** 11, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 16  
 **Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +16 (+20 grapple); **CMD** 30 (can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** Alertness, Improved Initiative, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (bite), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Bluff +16, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (planes) +13, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +12  
 **Languages** Ignan, Terran, Weirdling  
 **SQ** reform, transparency  

**Special Abilities**

 **Control Elemental (Ex)** Lava weirds can attempt to command any outsider with the “Earth,” “Elemental,” or “Fire” subtype that is within 50 feet. The Will save to avoid control has a DC of 21. The save DC is Charisma-based and includes a +4 racial bonus.
